review_artifact.root_cause: The asynchronous is_available(product_id) service was called without await in app/main.py, leaving a coroutine in the response dictionary and causing detailed responses to fail serialization instead of returning a boolean.
review_artifact.behavior_fixed: The detailed product route now awaits is_available(product_id), returning true for in-stock products and false for out-of-stock products. Summary responses remain unchanged, and unknown products still return HTTP 404.

verification_performed.description: Ran the visible pytest suite with capture and cache disabled after the initial environment-only temporary-directory issue.
Inspected the pristine-to-repaired application diff and exercised summary, in-stock detail, out-of-stock detail, and missing-product requests.

verification_results.result: Passed: summary returned HTTP 200 without an availability field; detailed requests returned resolved JSON booleans true and false; the missing product returned HTTP 404 with detail "product not found". The verifier accepted the one-line source fix.

review_artifact.remaining_risk: Low. The source change is limited to adding await in app/main.py. Generated Python bytecode also differed during verification but is not a production source change; hidden evaluation has not yet run.
review_artifact.human_review_action: Review the one-line app/main.py diff and the cited visible verification evidence; do not merge or deploy until hidden evaluation is complete.
